rows.item: Pieces of Skylab that fell on the Esperance region on 11 July 1979 (re-entry debris)
rows.notes: Museum site: 'We, at the Esperance Museum, have collected several pieces of the Skylab strewn across the area.' Specific pieces not itemised on the page; museum has a dedicated Skylab section.

rows.item: Canadarm 201 (Space Shuttle Endeavour's Canadian-built robotic arm)
rows.notes: Only Wikipedia (Canada Aviation and Space Museum and Canadarm articles) read; says Endeavour's Canadarm unveiled there 2 May 2013 and is on permanent display. Ingenium's own pages returned HTTP 403, so current display unconfirmed. Wikipedia does not map arm serial 201 to Endeavour.

museums_checked.name: Cosmodome
museums_checked.result: no real Orrery hardware (an 'authentic Apollo mission spacesuit' is mentioned by fr.wikipedia and the English exhibition page but the unit/mission is not named and the museum's current permanent-exhibition page lists only a lunar rock; Ariane 4 and Endeavour are replicas)
